message.content: {"draft":"Single-pass row mean. Use a power-of-two block sized to width (min 1024, max 8192) so most rows finish in one masked load; accumulate in FP32, divide by actual width, store in input dtype.","plan":"Keep one program per row. Compute BLOCK_SIZE = next_pow2(width) clamped to [1024, 8192]. Loop loads with mask, sum in FP32, divide by width, store scalar. Fresh contiguous output; inputs untouched.","code_lines":["import torch","import triton","import triton.language as tl","","","@triton.jit","def _row_mean_kernel(","    X,","    Y,","    stride,","    N,","    BLOCK_SIZE: tl.constexpr,","    N_ITERS: tl.constexpr,","):", "    row = tl.program_id(0)","    X += row * stride","    acc = tl.zeros([BLOCK_SIZE], dtype=tl.float32)","    for i in tl.static_range(N_ITERS):","        off = i * BLOCK_SIZE","        cols = off + tl.arange(0, BLOCK_SIZE)","        mask = cols < N","        a = tl.load(X + cols, mask=mask, other=0.).to(tl.float32)","        acc += a","    total = tl.sum(acc, axis=0)","    mean = total / N","    tl.store(Y + row, mean)","","","def _next_pow2(n):","    p = 1","    while p < n:","        p *= 2","    return p","","","def run(x):","    assert x.is_cuda","    assert x.dim() == 2","    assert x.is_contiguous()","    rows, width = x.shape","    out = torch.empty((rows,), dtype=x.dtype, device=x.device)","    if rows == 0 or width == 0:","        return out","    block = _next_pow2(width)","    if block < 1024:","        block = 1024","    if block > 8192:","        block = 8192","    n_iters = triton.cdiv(width, block)","    grid = (rows,)","    _row_mean_kernel[grid](x, out, width, width, BLOCK_SIZE=block, N_ITERS=n_iters)","    return out"]}
